title: Muzan Bebe Addon
description: This addon adds Muzan's flesh mass item to transform the player into a giant boss with massive status buffs like Strength V and Resistance V. (Requires Pehkui for scaling).
body:
🩸 Muzan Baby

Become the infamous Demon King in his baby form from Demon Slayer!

This mod adds a special item that allows players to transform into Muzan Baby, featuring a unique appearance inspired by Kimetsu no Yaiba.

📦 How to Obtain

Use the following command:

/give <player> muzanbebe

Example:

/give Steve muzanbebe
✨ Features
Transform into Muzan Baby
Custom model and appearance
Perfect for Demon Slayer roleplay servers
Easy to use
Multiplayer compatible
⚠️ Disclaimer

This is a fan-made mod inspired by Demon Slayer (Kimetsu no Yaiba) and is not affiliated with the original creators.


Added item textures and translation files (PT-BR and EN-US). Changed default .jar file name to MuzanBebeAddon.
